title: Agent Artifacts
subtitle: Govern the tenant-wide registry, recorded posture and supply-chain BOM for artifacts agents execute.
intro: This registry stores identity, provenance and recorded posture only — never skill bodies, manifests or instruction text.

registry.title: Registered artifacts
registry.description: Tenant-estate identities, provenance claims and recorded scanner results.
registry.emptyHint: An artifact never registered is not represented in the agent supply-chain BOM.

provenance.claimHint: The provenance is an operator claim and has not been marked reviewed.
provenance.verifiedHint: The operator reviewed the provenance claim; this is not an Olivares certification.

posture.hint: A grade records what a connector scanner graded or what an operator recorded. The console did not run a scan.

drawer.description: Stored registry metadata and its claim-versus-reviewed state.
drawer.identityNotice: Only metadata is stored. There is no artifact content behind this record.
drawer.postureNotice: A posture grade is a recorded scan result, not a scan performed by this console. Not scanned is neutral, not a failure.
drawer.name: Name

create.title: Register agent artifact
create.description: Record identity, provenance and posture metadata. The artifact content is never uploaded.
create.uniqueHint: Class and name form a unique, immutable registry identity. There is no update route.
create.name: Name
create.issuesHint: Issue count from the recorded result. Disabled and zero when not scanned.
create.verifiedHint: This attests that the operator reviewed the provenance claim; it is not an Olivares certification.
create.duplicate: An artifact with this class and name already exists. There is no update route; choose a different identity or delete the existing record first.

delete.title: Delete registered artifact
delete.description: Delete “{{name}}” from the registry? Future live BOMs will no longer include it.

registry.truncatedHint: There are more registered artifacts than shown; this page takes rows by id — assigned at creation — so rows beyond it are missing, normally the most recently registered. The class filter is applied by the ENGINE, so it re-queries; table search and sorting apply only to what is loaded. An artifact not listed here does not demonstrate that it is unregistered.

aibom.difference: This estate-wide BOM covers registered agent artifacts; the per-model AIBOM covers the lineage of one owned model.
aibom.coverage: Coverage reflects what was registered: an artifact never registered is not represented.

live.title: Live agent supply-chain BOM
live.description: Generated now — live, unsealed and unaudited.
live.notice: Previewing generates a fresh CycloneDX 1.6 document from the current registry. It is read-only and does not create evidence.
live.dialogDescription: Generated from the registry now. This document is not sealed or audited.

seal.confirmDescription: This re-generates the BOM and commits its canonical content hash to the audit ledger. The ledger does not archive the document.
seal.confirmBody: Keep the returned receipt: its AIBOM is the only copy of the sealed document.
seal.success: Agent supply-chain BOM sealed. Download the receipt's BOM now.
seal.receiptDescription: The hash commitment is durable; this receipt contains the only copy of the sealed document.

history.title: Seal history
history.description: Append-only models.agent_aibom commitments for the registered agent-artifact estate.
history.emptyHint: Sealing creates a hash commitment and returns the only document copy in its receipt.
history.loadError: Could not load the seal history.
history.subject: Subject
history.truncatedHint: There are more sealed AI-BOMs than shown; this page takes rows by id. Sealing appends a row, so what is missing is normally the most recent evidence.
